def preprocess(text):
    text = re.sub(r"https?://\S+|www\.\S+", "", text)  # URL除去
    text = re.sub(r"<.*?>", "", text)  # HTML除去
    emoji_pattern = re.compile("["
        u"\U0001F600-\U0001F64F"
        u"\U0001F300-\U0001F5FF"
        u"\U0001F680-\U0001F6FF"
        u"\U0001F1E0-\U0001F1FF"
        u"\U00002702-\U000027B0"
        u"\U000024C2-\U0001F251"
        "]+", flags=re.UNICODE)
    text = emoji_pattern.sub(r"", text)
    text = text.translate(str.maketrans('', '', string.punctuation))
    return text

import spacy
from tqdm.auto import tqdm

# Загружаем модель spaCy один раз
try:
    nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
except OSError:
    print("Модель 'en_core_web_sm' не найдена. Установите: python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm")
    raise

def process_dataframe(input_df):
    """
    Применяет полный пайплайн обработки к датафрейму (тренировочному или тестовому).
    """
    print(f"Обработка датафрейма размером {input_df.shape}...")
    df = input_df.copy() # Работаем с копией, чтобы не изменять оригинал

    # 1. Создание бинарных признаков
    df['keyword_is_missing'] = df['keyword'].isnull().astype(int)
    df['location_is_missing'] = df['location'].isnull().astype(int)

    # 2. Восстановление 'location' с помощью NER
    locations_to_fill = df[df['location'].isnull()]
    if not locations_to_fill.empty:
        tqdm.pandas(desc="Поиск локаций")
        found_locations = locations_to_fill['text'].progress_apply(
            lambda text: next((ent.text for ent in nlp(text).ents if ent.label_ == 'GPE'), None)
        )
        df.loc[df['location'].isnull(), 'location'] = found_locations

    # 3. Восстановление 'keyword'
    # Используем уникальные ключевые слова только из ТРЕНИРОВОЧНОГО набора, чтобы избежать утечки данных
    unique_keywords = train_df['keyword'].dropna().unique().tolist()
    keywords_to_fill = df[df['keyword'].isnull()]
    if not keywords_to_fill.empty:
        def find_keyword_in_text(text):
            for keyword in unique_keywords:
                if re.search(r'\b' + re.escape(keyword) + r'\b', text, re.IGNORECASE):
                    return keyword
            return None
        tqdm.pandas(desc="Поиск ключевых слов")
        found_keywords = keywords_to_fill['text'].progress_apply(find_keyword_in_text)
        df.loc[df['keyword'].isnull(), 'keyword'] = found_keywords

    # 4. Финальная очистка
    df['keyword'].fillna('unknown', inplace=True)
    df['location'].fillna('unknown', inplace=True)

    # 5. Создание комбинированного поля
    df['combined_text'] = (
        df['text'] +
        ' [SEP] ' + df['keyword'] +
        ' [SEP] ' + df['location']
    )
    
    print("Обработка завершена.")
    return df

def add_text_features(df, text_column='text'):
    df['word_count'] = df[text_column].apply(lambda x: len(str(x).split()))
    df['unique_word_count'] = df[text_column].apply(lambda x: len(set(str(x).split())))
    df['stop_word_count'] = df[text_column].apply(lambda x: len([w for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in set]))
    df['url_count'] = df[text_column].apply(lambda x: len([w for w in str(x).lower().split() if 'http' in w or 'https' in w]))
    df['mean_word_length'] = df[text_column].apply(lambda x: numpy.mean([len(w) for w in str(x).split()]) if len(str(x).split()) > 0 else 0)

import re
import html
import emoji
import string

# === 1. 略語辞書と関数 ===
CONTRACTION_MAP = {
    "can't": "cannot", "I'm": "I am", "he's": "he is", "you're": "you are", "it's": "it is",
    "won't": "will not", "they've": "they have", "we're": "we are", "didn't": "did not",
    "hasn't": "has not", "haven't": "have not", "I'd": "I would", "we'll": "we will"
    # 必要に応じて追加してOK
}

def expand_contractions(text, contraction_map=CONTRACTION_MAP):
    pattern = re.compile('({})'.format('|'.join(re.escape(k) for k in contraction_map.keys())),
                         flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
    def expand_match(match):
        found = match.group(0)
        lower_found = found.lower()
        expanded = contraction_map.get(found) or contraction_map.get(lower_found)
        if expanded:
            return expanded[0].upper() + expanded[1:] if found[0].isupper() else expanded
        return found
    return pattern.sub(expand_match, text)

# === 2. BERT向けクリーニング関数 ===
def clean_text_for_bert(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return ''
    text = html.unescape(text)
    text = emoji.demojize(text, delimiters=(" ", " "))
    text = expand_contractions(text)
    text = re.sub(r'http\S+|www\S+|https\S+', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r'@\w+', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r'#(\w+)', r'\1', text)
    text = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9\s.,!?\'`]', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r'(.)\1{2,}', r'\1\1', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()
    return text

# === 3. 通常クリーニング関数 ===
def clean_text_traditional(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        text = text.lower()
        text = re.sub(r'http\S+|www\S+|https\S+', '', text)
        text = re.sub(r'@\w+|#\w+', '', text)
        text = text.translate(str.maketrans('', '', string.punctuation))
        text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()
        return text
    else:
        return ''

def remove_emoji(text):
    emoji_pattern = re.compile(
        '['

        u'\U0001F300-\U0001F5FF'  # symbols & pictographs
        u'\U0001F680-\U0001F6FF'  # transport & map symbols

    return emoji_pattern.sub(r'', text)

import re
import unicodedata

def clean_text(text):
    # Ensure input is a string
    text = str(text)
    
    # 1. Remove non-standard Unicode characters (commonly causes garbled text)
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("utf-8", "ignore")
    
    # 2. Remove HTML tags
    text = re.sub(r"<.*?>", "", text)

    # 3. Remove URLs
    text = re.sub(r"http\S+|www\S+|https\S+", "", text, flags=re.MULTILINE)

    # 4. Remove non-alphabetic characters (optional)
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z\s]", "", text)

    # 5. Convert text to lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    
    # 6. Remove extra whitespaces
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()

    return text

# テキストクリーニング用の関数を定義
def clean_text(text):
    text = re.sub(r'https?://\S+|www\.\S+', '', text) # URLを除去
    text = re.sub(r'<.*?>', '', text) # HTMLタグを除去
    emoji_pattern = re.compile(
        '['
        '\U0001F600-\U0001F64F' '\U0001F300-\U0001F5FF'
        '\U0001F680-\U0001F6FF' '\U0001F1E0-\U0001F1FF'
        '\U00002702-\U000027B0' '\U000024C2-\U0001F251'
        ']+',
        flags=re.UNICODE
    )
    text = emoji_pattern.sub(r'', text) # 絵文字を除去
    text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', '', text) # 句読点を除去
    text = re.sub(r'\d+', '', text) # 数字を除去
    text = text.lower() # 小文字に変換
    return text

# --- TF-IDF特徴量の生成（ngram_rangeを(1,2)に設定） ---
# ngram_range=(1,2)で、ユニグラム（単一の単語）とバイグラム（2つの連続した単語）を特徴量として含める
tfidf_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(min_df=5, max_df=0.8, max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2))

# train_dfとtest_dfのprocessed_text列を結合してTF-IDFを学習
# 訓練データとテストデータ全体で単語辞書を構築することで、一貫した特徴量が得られる

# 訓練データとテストデータにTF-IDF変換を適用

X_test_tfidf = tfidf_vectorizer.transform(test_df['processed_text'])


# --- keyword列のOne-Hot Encoding ---
# OneHotEncoderのインスタンスを作成（handle_unknown='ignore'でテストデータにないカテゴリを無視）
# sparse_output=Trueで疎行列を返すため、メモリ効率が良い

# テキストクリーニング用の関数を定義
def clean_text(text):
    # URLを除去
    text = re.sub(r'https?://\S+|www\.\S+', '', text)
    # HTMLタグを除去
    text = re.sub(r'<.*?>', '', text)
    # 絵文字を除去（広範囲な絵文字に対応）
    emoji_pattern = re.compile(
        '['
        '\U0001F600-\U0001F64F'  # Emoticons
        '\U0001F300-\U0001F5FF'  # Symbols & Pictographs
        '\U0001F680-\U0001F6FF'  # Transport & Map Symbols
        '\U0001F1E0-\U0001F1FF'  # Flags (iOS)
        '\U00002702-\U000027B0'
        '\U000024C2-\U0001F251'
        ']+',
        flags=re.UNICODE
    )
    text = emoji_pattern.sub(r'', text)
    # 句読点を除去
    text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', '', text)
    # 数字を除去
    text = re.sub(r'\d+', '', text)
    # 小文字に変換
    text = text.lower()
    return text

# Define a function for minimal cleaning
def minimal_cleaning(text):
    text = text.replace('\n', ' ')            # replace \n with a space
    text = text.replace('w/', ' with ')       # replace w/ with 'with'
    text = text.replace('&amp', ' and ')      # replace &amp with 'and'
    text = text.replace('Ûªm', ' am ')        # replace Ûªm with 'am'
    text = re.sub(r'@\S+', '@USER', text)     # replace mentions with @USER
    text = re.sub(r'http\S+', 'HTTPURL', text) #replace url with 'HTTPURL'
    text = re.sub(r'#\S+', '#TOPIC', text)    # replace hashtags with #TOPIC
    text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)          # remove extra space

    return text

def train_step(model, dataloader, optimizer, loss_fn, device):
    model.train()
    train_loss, train_accu = (0, 0)
    for i, data in enumerate(dataloader):
        input_ids = data['input_ids'].to(str)
        attention_mask = data['attention_mask'].to(str)
        token_type_ids = data['token_type_ids'].to(str)
        pandas.core.indexes.base.Index = data['labels'].to(str)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, token_type_ids)
        loss = loss_fn(logits, pandas.core.indexes.base.Index)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += loss.item()
        y_preds = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1).argmax(dim=1)
        accu = (y_preds == pandas.core.indexes.base.Index).sum().item() / len(y_preds)
        train_accu += accu
    train_loss /= len(dataloader)
    train_accu /= len(dataloader)

from tqdm.auto import tqdm

# Define train_epoch function with early stopping and checkpoint
def train_epoch(model, train_dataloader, eval_dataloader, 
                optimizer, loss_fn, early_stop_patience, 
                checkpoint_file, device, epochs=10):

    # Create the results dictionary
    results = {
        "train_loss": [],
        'train_accu': [],
        "eval_loss": [],
        "eval_accu": []
    }

    # Setup best_epoch and best_accuracy values
    best_epoch = -1
    best_accu = -1
    
    # Loop through epochs
    for epoch in tqdm(range(1, epochs+1)):
        # Train step
        train_loss, train_accu = train_step(model=model, 
                                dataloader=train_dataloader, 
                                optimizer=optimizer, 
                                loss_fn=loss_fn, 
                                device=device)
        
        # Evaluation step
        eval_loss, eval_accu = eval_step(model=model, 
                                         dataloader=eval_dataloader, 
                                         loss_fn=loss_fn, 
                                         device=device)
        # Print out what's happening
        print(f"Epoch: {epoch} |"
              f"train_loss: {train_loss:.4f} |"
              f"train_accu: {train_accu:.4f} |"
              f"eval_loss: {eval_loss:.4f} |"
              f"eval_accu: {eval_accu:.4f}")

        # Update the results dictionary
        results['train_loss'].append(train_loss)
        results['train_accu'].append(train_accu)
        results['eval_loss'].append(eval_loss)
        results['eval_accu'].append(eval_accu)

        # Checkpoint + Early Stopping
        if eval_accu > best_accu:
            best_accu = eval_accu
            best_epoch = epoch
            checkpoint(model, checkpoint_file)
        elif epoch - best_epoch >= early_stop_patience:
            print(f"Early stopped at epoch {epoch}."
                  f"Best eval_accu {best_accu} at epoch {best_epoch}.")
            resume_checkpoint(model, checkpoint_file)
            return results

    # Save the best model in the end
    resume_checkpoint(model, checkpoint_file)
    print(f"Finished training."
          f"Best eval_accu {best_accu} at epoch {best_epoch}.")
    return results

def clean_text(text):
    # Ensure input is a string

    # 1. Remove non-standard Unicode characters (commonly causes garbled text)

    # 4. Remove non-alphabetic characters (optional)
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z\s]", "", text)

    # 5. Convert text to lowercase
    text = text.lower()

def clean_text_for_bert(text):

    text = re.sub(r'https?://\S+|www\.\S+', '', text)

    text = re.sub(r'<.*?>', '', text)

    emoji_pattern = re.compile(
        '['
        '\U0001F600-\U0001F64F' '\U0001F300-\U0001F5FF'
        '\U0001F680-\U0001F6FF' '\U0001F1E0-\U0001F1FF'
        '\U00002702-\U000027B0' '\U000024C2-\U0001F251'
        ']+',
        flags=re.UNICODE
    )
    text = emoji_pattern.sub(r'', text)
    return text

tokenizer = BertTokenizer.from_pretrained('bert-base-uncased', do_lower_case=True)

def encode_texts(tokenizer, texts, max_len=128):
    input_ids = []
    attention_masks = []
    for text in texts:
        encoded_dict = tokenizer.encode_plus(
                            text,
                            add_special_tokens = True,
                            max_length = max_len,
                            padding = 'max_length',
                            truncation = True,
                            return_attention_mask = True,
                            return_tensors = 'pt',
                       )

        input_ids.append(encoded_dict['input_ids'])
        attention_masks.append(encoded_dict['attention_mask'])
    
    input_ids = torch.cat(input_ids, dim=0)
    attention_masks = torch.cat(attention_masks, dim=0)

    return input_ids, attention_masks

# Text cleaning is required since there are mentions, retweets, URLs, emojis, etc. that could be in the tweets. Remove these.
# These are the libraries for text modifications
import re
import emoji
get_ipython().system('pip install contractions')
import contractions
import html

# Create function to clean up the tweets to be plain text
# Get rid of additional characters or symbols
# Credit belongs to https://www.kaggle.com/code/muhammadfaseeh/kerasnlp-starter-notebook-disaster-tweets
def get_clean_tweets(text):
    
    # Rid the tweets of any extra spaces leading or following the first or last word
    text = text.strip()
    
    # Convert HTML entities
    text = html.unescape(text)
    
    # Fix corrupted Unicode artifacts
    text = text.replace("‰ÛÏ", '"').replace("‰Û", '"')  # Fix double quotes
    text = text.replace("‰Û÷", "'").replace("‰Ûª", "'")  # Fix single quotes
    text = text.replace("‰Û¢", "-").replace("‰Û_", "-")  # Fix hyphen issues
    
    # Remove any remaining corrupted symbols
    text = re.sub(r"[^\x00-\x7F]+", "", text)  # Remove remaining non-ASCII characters
    
    # Remove URLs that start with 'https://...' or any links
    text = re.sub(r'http\S+', '', text)
    
    # Remove mentions (@username)
    text = re.sub(r'@\w+', '', text)
    
    # Remove any emojis - had no idea that there was a library that could get this done
    text = emoji.demojize(text, delimiters=(" ", " "))  
    
    # Expand contractions
    text = contractions.fix(text)

    return text

# Apply to both train and test tweets columns in datasets
train_data['text'] = train_data['text'].apply(get_clean_tweets)
test_data['text'] = test_data['text'].apply(get_clean_tweets)

from fastai.text.all import *
import pandas as pd

train_df = pd.read_csv('/kaggle/input/nlp-getting-started/train.csv')
test_df = pd.read_csv('/kaggle/input/nlp-getting-started/test.csv')

dls = TextDataLoaders.from_df(
    train_df, 
    text_col='text', 
    label_col='target', 
    valid_pct=0.2, 
    is_lm=False
)

learn = text_classifier_learner(dls, AWD_LSTM, metrics=accuracy)
learn.fine_tune(4)

test_dl = dls.test_dl(test_df['text'])

preds, _ = learn.get_preds(dl=test_dl)
labels = preds.argmax(dim=1)

submission = pd.DataFrame({
    'id': test_df['id'],
    'target': labels
})

submission.to_csv('submission.csv', index=False)
